title: Pinned SDK and harness public-symbol acceptance inventory
native_observation: Initial mutable-working-tree symbol observation plus explicitly scoped later updates in native_progress_updates. Unrelated initial native hashes/type/test candidate counts remain historical, not an immutable full runtime-verification checkpoint.
purpose: An inclusive union acceptance backlog for full native parity; symbol counts and matching names are not completion percentages or behavioral equivalence.

source_policy.typescript: All 45 SDK and 2 harness package export keys, including types/default/node conditions, resolved using the locally installed TypeScript compiler API. Type and value surfaces are retained; @internal declarations exposed by barrels are flagged. Selected top-level expression-statement side effects are recorded; this is not exhaustive runtime effect analysis.
source_policy.python: Every public path beneath strands and strands_harness, honoring static __all__, resolving relative/absolute repository import chains, and enumerating recognized literal lazy __getattr__ branches, literal alias dictionaries and known forwarding modules. Modules without __all__ list Python's non-underscore bindings, including explicitly marked external/type-checking/conditional bindings; this is not a claim all incidental imports are intentional SDK contracts.
source_policy.members: Declared public class/interface members are included; each member's source is its containing declaration source. Inherited, synthesized, overload-resolution, structural typing, function signatures, decorators' generated schemas and side-effect behavior need behavioral acceptance tests.
source_policy.native: Manually curated related concepts are distinguished from case-normalized lexical candidates. Native declaration discovery is lexical and is not a compiled public-ABI baseline; source references and family test references support subsequent review.
source_policy.baseline_integrity: git diff against pinned commit is empty for all four upstream SDK/harness source trees.
source_policy.validation: Static generation and repository reference validation only; no build, SDK import, optional dependency loading, provider service call, or test execution was performed by this inventory generation.

language_union_policy.default: Implement the inclusive union of substantive TS and Python behavior. Language-only types or binding mechanisms need an explicit native disposition rather than exact spelling.
language_union_policy.conflicts: Expose explicit mode/options when upstream semantics conflict and document the native default. Graph defaults use TS AND/ready-node/snapshot-restore; GraphOptions.Python selects OR/completed-batch/retained state.
language_union_policy.no_automatic_closure: A matching class or family does not close its members, configuration fields, wire formats, lifecycle, cancellation, sessions or acceptance scenarios.

next_acceptance_slices.scope: Durable graph sessions and nested interrupt routing before Swarm reuse
Source-backed handoff tools, next-node selection, limits, callback events and context/state policy
InterventionHandler/actions over working middleware and interruption prerequisites
Native ActivitySource/Meter model/tool/agent lifecycle with source-equivalent privacy policy
Strands task lifecycle/reconnect and declarative auth over official raw protocol

native_mapping_status_definitions.explicit_concept_mapping_requires_confor: Manually curated related native constructs at capability level. Not an independently verified per-symbol signature/member/behavior equivalence.
native_mapping_status_definitions.candidate_name_match_requires_review: Case/idiom-normalized lexical name resemblance only; no parity inference.
native_mapping_status_definitions.no_native_symbol_mapping: A missing capability, unrecognized idiomatic alias or language-specific DTO requiring explicit disposition. Family implementation never closes it automatically.

capability_status_definitions.absent: No substantive native implementation found for this capability.
capability_status_definitions.partial: Related native behavior exists with explicit remaining capability gaps.
capability_status_definitions.implemented_subset: A substantive executable subset exists, with unclosed symbols/member behavior and named gaps remaining.
capability_status_definitions.not_a_verified_pinned_sdk_export: The source-backed audit did not establish this as a pinned SDK/harness export requirement.

statistics.native_observation_note: Native type/test candidate totals are the initial observation; symbol dispositions include the explicit scoped updates. They are not a completion percentage.

remaining_capabilities: Explicit progress and rich terminal output exist; native C# uses a terminal event instead of an async-generator return value.
upstream_behavior_differences: TS async generators return a final ToolResultBlock separately from yielded progress; a C# async enumerable needs an explicit terminal-result representation or separate completion contract.

remaining_capabilities: Native reflection/delegate schema generation exists; Python decorator and TS Zod binding identities are language-specific.
upstream_behavior_differences: Python decorators and TS Zod schemas are language integrations, not libraries to transplant into C#.

remaining_capabilities: AddTool/AddTools and optional ToolFilter exist; direct Agent tool-caller API, complete dynamic/lazy providers/module-loading and registry lifecycle are not implemented.
upstream_behavior_differences: Native configuration resolves explicit CLR bindings rather than evaluating arbitrary Python/TypeScript module code.

remaining_capabilities: Model/tool stage registries and agent integration exist; this is not a claim that vended intervention packages are implemented.
Core interruption supplies human responses; the upstream InterventionHandler/actions/policy abstraction is not implemented.

Native agent and Graph/Swarm human routing, selected snapshots and latest-session recovery exist. Experimental checkpoint history/trigger/manifest and foreign-format conformance remain separate acceptance work.
Awaited initialization/invocation/model/tool/batch/message/shutdown hooks and correlated ToolResultEvent/ToolStreamUpdateEvent/InterruptEvent exist.
ContentBlockEvent, ModelMessageEvent and the MultiAgentPlugin lifecycle/state contract remain absent.

Native AND/OR scheduling, node/agent nesting, snapshots, human routing, crash frontier and selected latest-node/invocation storage exist. Generic multi-agent plugins, tracing and full per-member/export conformance remain open.
upstream_behavior_differences: TS graph documents AND dependency semantics; Python uses OR semantics over completed batches.
TS schedules individually ready nodes; Python schedules batches.
TS agent nodes reset by default; Python preserves state unless reset_on_revisit.
TS node failures become FAILED results while step limits throw; Python documents inverse behavior.

remaining_capabilities: Generic multi-agent plugin lifecycle/export/member conformance remains open; native hook callbacks alone do not close the plugin contract.
Multi-agent OpenTelemetry spans, trace attributes and tracer-specific acceptance tests remain open.
Python vended swarm tool and the A2A/bidirectional agent families are separate work.
Native snapshot JSON is not the foreign TS/Python wire format; migration/import conformance is separate.
Per-symbol signatures and all members remain subject to EXPORT_SYMBOL_INVENTORY conformance; related names do not establish full parity.
upstream_behavior_differences: TS swarm chooses routing through structured output; Python injects handoff_to_agent.
TS maxSteps and serialized JSON context differ from Python separate limits and shared context.
explicit_native_differences: Pending visit continuation consumes no additional logical MaxSteps visit; TypeScript increments its loop counter for resume attempts.
Multiple tool handoffs use normalized accepted success and assistant call order, rather than timing-dependent body mutations.
AfterNode cleanup callbacks run for paused visits; Python suppresses this callback while interrupted.
Synchronous construction defers reset snapshot capture until initialization; CreateAsync captures before returning.
Finite portable deadlines are validated within Int32 milliseconds; null represents an unbounded deadline.
Caller cancellation cooperatively drains owned iterators and propagates even under failed-result policies.

remaining_capabilities: No A2A agent-card discovery, protocol client/server/executor, streaming task conversion, endpoint allowlist tool or context/task store.
upstream_behavior_differences: Server host adapters are language-specific: TS includes Express; Python uses its own ASGI/server integration.

remaining_capabilities: No BidiAgent, realtime audio IO/event loop, Nova Sonic/Gemini Live/OpenAI Realtime model contracts, restart/session control or audio buffering.
upstream_behavior_differences: No corresponding bidi package export exists in pinned strands-ts/package.json; this expands beyond common TS/Python functionality.

remaining_capabilities: Usage counters and Trace diagnostics exist, but no native ActivitySource/Meter or OpenTelemetry agent/model/tool spans, exporters, baggage policy or local AgentTrace/AgentMetrics equivalents.

upstream_behavior_differences: No matching Python decisions package was found; do not invent this as a common SDK gap.

remaining_capabilities: Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI Chat/Responses and Google adapters exist; inspect provider-level unsupported wire features and routing strategy gaps independently.
upstream_behavior_differences: TS OpenAIModel defaults to Responses with an api selector; native uses separate OpenAIModel (Chat) and OpenAIResponsesModel types.
Unknown model IDs use documented estimated fallback metadata rather than a live provider catalog.

remaining_capabilities: Native Ollama exists in this working tree; LiteLLM, LlamaAPI, llama.cpp, Mistral, SageMaker, Writer and TS Vercel adapters remain absent.
upstream_behavior_differences: Some are language SDK bridges (Vercel, LiteLLM, llama-cpp-python); equivalent capability or native alternate integration needs explicit design rather than importing foreign libraries.

ambiguities: Python modules without __all__ expose incidental imported names under language semantics; external bindings are recorded separately and are not assumed parity requirements.
Python __getattr__ literal branches are enumerated, but arbitrary dynamic behavior is explicitly unresolved and is never executed.
TypeScript external package types are not installed or typechecked; successful export alias resolution is not a clean typecheck or a provider compatibility result.
Declarations exported through multiple entrypoints are canonicalized by origin source/name; conditional entrypoint variants retain separate exported-name links.
Public @internal TypeScript declarations are flagged for maintainer intent review rather than silently dropped.
Native symbol aliases are conceptual mappings with family-level evidence, not signature or behavioral equivalence. Missing mappings require disposition even inside implemented families.

Runtime test evidence must be taken from the immutable checkpoint validation report. A local net48 target can execute on installed Framework4.8.1; it is not proof of the separate clean Framework4.8 gate.

native_progress_updates.scope: Graph durable recovery, Swarm routing/reset/human/session policies and invocation-local borrowed tools; other symbol mappings remain at their recorded observations.
